description: UPL - Faja biodiversa conectividad. Bogotá D.C is a dataset listed in City of Bogotá open data portal (Datos Abiertos Bogotá), an open data portal, published or maintained by Secretaría Distrital de Planeación - SDP. Área geográfica que se caracteriza por tener una gran variedad de especies animales y vegetales, en la cual se pretende generar corredores biológicos que facilitan el movimiento de especies de fauna que habitan los relictos boscosos. Coverage: Bogotá. The portal files it under the publisher Secretaría Distrital de Planeación - SDP. Its tags are Bogotá DC, Decreto 555 de 2021, Formulación, Norma Urbana, POT. It offers 5 resource(s) in DXF, GEOJSON, GPKG, KMZ, SHP. The portal shows 2024-10-23 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network deployment studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-bogota-portal.
